2014_subclasses.transmutation.descriptio:
Transmuters manipulate the physical world. They can change the shape and properties of objects, transform one substance into another, and even alter their own bodies.

The study of transmutation requires a deep understanding of the natural world. Transmuters learn to reshape reality at a fundamental level, using their abilities to adapt to any situation and overcome any obstacle.
2014_subclasses.transmutation.savant.des: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a transmutation spell into your spellbook is halved.
2014_subclasses.transmutation.savant.sum: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a transmutation spell into your spellbook is halved. (action).
2014_subclasses.transmutation.minor-alch: Also at 2nd level, you can transmute materials.
At 2nd level, you can transmute one object into another material of the same size and value. The effect lasts for 1 hour or until the object takes any damage.
